name: comp-276
blurb: Bordered warning alert with action link.
description: Bordered warning alert with an embedded action link. Combines visual prominence of a bordered alert with the interactivity of linked actions.
use_when: Warning messages at form section or page level that benefit from an inline action.
avoid_when: Simple warnings without actions. When action should be a separate button element.
a11y: Links are keyboard focusable. Alert role and aria-live should be added by parent for screen reader announcements.
